claim_text: Speculative quality may depend on keeping sociotechnical assumptions contestable across making and evaluation rather than on technical correctness alone.
evidence_requirement: Human results from both studies plus cross-stage conflict evidence and falsification checks.
boundary_language: Treat as a headline hypothesis until the full evidence path is verified.

claim_text: The local apparatus implements deterministic counterbalancing, fixed candidate generation, local semantic preservation, blinded manifests, and a zero-external-request experiment path.
evidence_requirement: Deterministic unit tests, browser smoke test, local-request audit, and reproducible synthetic pipeline.
boundary_language: This is an engineering and protocol claim, not a human outcome claim.

claim_text: Semantically addressable local editing changes assumption-level revision activity relative to prompt-mediated whole-output editing in the recruited maker sample, under a verified locality manipulation and common undo controls.
evidence_requirement: Completed and coded Study A human returns with paired analysis and qualitative traces; candidate-level off-target exposure is a manipulation check only.
boundary_language: Limit to the recruited makers, three briefs, fixed simulator, and frozen codebook.

claim_text: The ambiguity-preserving protocol changes grounded interpretive breadth in the common probe while retaining basic comprehension in the recruited audience sample.
evidence_requirement: Powered Study B human returns; blinded coding; comprehension; response-length and dwell-time diagnostics.
boundary_language: Limit to implemented protocol and audience; withhold productive-ambiguity language if comprehension or verbosity gates fail.

claim_text: Repeated trace-linked cases show that technical PASS cannot by itself determine audience interpretive value or expert curatorial KEEP.
evidence_requirement: Completed technical audits, maker traces, audience probes, expert decisions, and rationale-based conflict analysis.
boundary_language: Report situated discordance; do not infer universal independence or non-substitution from isolated cases.

claim_text: Synthetic records, current Layered Redraw traces, and earlier CAC annotations do not establish human contestability effects in this study.
evidence_requirement: Provenance separation and explicit synthetic/human gates.
boundary_language: This boundary applies to title, abstract, results, contribution list, and conclusion.
